Las Terrenas

LAS BALLENAS BEACH

Named Las Ballenas because of three rocks in the distance that resemble humpback whales; this spacious and wide white sand beach boasts a shallow and calm sea right in the heart of the small town of Las Terrenas. With hotels, villas, bars and restaurants on one side of the beach it offers plenty of shade and shallow water ideal for families. Along the west end is where the river meets the sea and where you'll see locals cooling off in the cool waters. Las Ballenas beach is ideal for a morning or sunset swim due to its close proximity to various accommodations and restaurants.

FOR A MORE ENJOYABLE STAY, HERE ARE SOME FUN FILLED ACTIVITIES

Take a 4 wheel adventure along the beach line for fun, experimenting or to do your town shopping. Jog along the shore with the sunset at your side, swim the crystalline warm waters, sunbathe or massage your feet in the soft white sand.

• Do some adventurous horseback riding at the Salto Del Limon River and
Waterfall
• Whale watching in Samana Bay, (January-March)
• Sail in a catamaran, go snorkeling or scuba diving
• Explore the Islets, mangroves and caves in Los Haitises National Park
• Fishing, sailboat rental (with a crew)
• Eco tours by car, jeep, and horse or mountain bike around the area
• Boat tour to the tropical island of Cayo Levantado
• Surfing (September- November)
• Kite Surfing (December-September)
• Spa treatment are available at the Turkish Spa and Beauty Salon
• Shop for souvenirs and handcrafts in town
• Enjoy nightlife at the Fisherman’s Village.

Frequently Asked Questions

FAQ's

Where do I get the keys to the property?

Keys are delivered personally by our concierge upon arrival.

Is the property located in a safe place?

The property is located within the Bonita Village Complex with 24 hour security

How far from the beach is the property?

Playa Las Ballenas is about 7 minutes from the property on foot, crossing the garden of the complex where the common pool is located.

Is the Jacuzzi heated?

All Jacuzzis have a heater

What cleaning and disinfection measures are you implementing?

Our cleaning team does a rigorous daily cleaning of all units and we follow the strictest disinfection controls in all areas of the establishment.

Are there any additional charges for electricity?

All rentals include electricity and air conditioning in all rooms only in the case of Penthouses there is an additional charge for the use of central air for the living and dining areas of $ 20 dollars per night.

What happens to my reservation if my flight is canceled or everything is closed again because of COVID

If due to some force majeure reason you cannot make your trip, you have the option of moving the dates to the future within 45 days of your original reservation.

What are the hours of the complex's common pool?

The pool hours are from 7:00 am to 7:00 pm

Do you allow pets?

This has some flexibility for small, trained pets with a security deposit in case of damage.

FAQ's

Is the Duplex Pool heated?

Pools are not heated only the Jacuzzi.

Am I allowed to play loud music and until what time?

Out of respect for other guests, the rule is that you can listen to music at decent levels and after 11:00 PM it should be at a level you can have a normal conversation

Will we be alone in the apartment or is it shared?

Each apartment is independent from the others with a private entrance. Shared spaces such as stairs and parking lots green areas are wide so they allow distance.

Is there a restaurant within the complex?

There are no restaurants within the Bonita Village complex. All are located along Playa Las Ballenas.

Does it include breakfast?

We provide complimentary Chef Service for Breakfast
(guests provide the groceries) * only at the Ribera Mar properties

Golf carts and ATV’s are available for rent.

Do you have beach umbrellas available?

We do not have beach umbrellas. Villa Playa and Villa blu have Chaise Lounge available

At what distance from the property are the shops Supermarkets, restaurants

All shops, supermarkets, banks, pastries are about 10-12 minutes from the properties.

Do you have a washing machine and tumble dryer?

All units have a washing machine and clothesline.

The chef service is complementary for breakfast at Ribera Mar and has a cost of $ 35 dollars for the preparation of lunch or dinner for the group.

About Us

What is Ribera Mar

Ribera Mar is a 5 apartment complex located within the Bonita Village Residence, Playa Las Ballenas, Las Terrenas, Samana in the Dominican Republic, built by Constructora Arpel. The Complex consists of 2 Duplex apartments, 2 Penthouse apartments and a ground floor condo. Each detailed in the most exquisite taste, luxury and comfort, all for your personal enjoyment and care.

Distinction

This modern full-of-comfort ocean view Caribbean property at the paradise location of Las Terrenas, Dominican Republic, located in a private 24 hour surveillance residential area at the Bonita Village Residence, just 7 minutes away from Las Ballenas Beach, one of the finest beaches in the Caribbean, and only five minutes away from the most famous fine-dining restaurants, bars and dance clubs at the Fisherman’s Village (Pueblo de Los Pescadores); offering endless moments of fun, relaxation, and loving memories you’ll always remember.

Our philosophy

This exclusive property was designed with the intention of preserving the essence of its surroundings by conserving the green areas and the Salt River running water into the sea, tucked away in a secluded cove by Las Ballenas Beach, offering our guests a unique and private outdoor experience.

Style and comfort

If a great first impression is what you are expecting, prepare to be amazed more than once. You will be dazzled from the moment you arrive at our property until you settle in. In spite of the proximity to the life and movement of the Fisherman’s Village, you will enjoy quiet moments and privacy due to its privileged location at the end of Las Ballenas Beach

ARPELS

Ribera mar by Arpels

History

Constructora Arpel has successfully developed residential constructions in the Dominican real estate market; making it a reliable brand that provides high quality standards and benefits to its purchasers. Our projects are available for immediate purchase or in the drawing stage; all develop under a minimalist concept; both in spaces, form, language, as well as in the articulation of good taste and the demands of the current market, always seeking to fully comply with the needs of our investors.

Our focus

Is based on contemporary interior and architectural designs, fine finishes, modern facades and strategic locations that allow you to enjoy exuberant panoramic views of the city, the sea and the mountains, which make “ARPEL" a synonym for optimization and elegance.

Who we are

Our website address is: http://riberamar.com.

What personal data we collect and why we collect it

Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Contact forms

Cookies

If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Analytics

Who we share your data with

How long we retain your data

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where we send your data

Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.
